prompt.brief: Design a Facebook Marketplace feature where people list products, discover nearby items, search and filter inventory, message sellers, and complete listing and moderation workflows at large scale.
successSignals: Separate listing source data, search indexes, image media, messaging, and recommendation projections.
Make location and category search scalable while keeping listing ownership and status authoritative.
Handle ranking, seller safety, fraud, moderation, and stale inventory explicitly.
Use asynchronous indexing and notifications without making listing creation depend on every downstream consumer.

functional: Create, edit, pause, and remove listings with title, description, price, category, condition, location, and photos.
Search nearby inventory with text, category, price, distance, and freshness filters.
View listing details, save items, contact sellers, and report suspicious listings.
Notify sellers of messages and buyers of listing changes while supporting moderation and audit actions.
nonFunctional: A listing must be durable before it appears in the owner's inventory.
Target p95 below 300 ms for a cached search page and below 500 ms for an uncached query.
Search results may be eventually consistent but must not return deleted, blocked, or sold listings after policy recheck.
Protect users from spam, location leakage, fraud, abusive content, and notification storms.
scaleAssumptions: 100 million active listings, 50 million daily searches, and 20,000 peak search requests per second.
Listings have one or more images and are concentrated in geographic and category hot spots.
Most listing edits are infrequent, but popular products and local events create hot queries.
Messages and reports require durable delivery, while recommendations and counters are rebuildable.

metrics.label: Search throughput
metrics.description: Provision read replicas, index shards, and cache for bursty local queries.

metrics.label: Search latency
metrics.description: Bound candidate retrieval, ranking, and policy filtering.

metrics.label: Index freshness
metrics.description: New or edited listings become searchable asynchronously within the target.

metrics.label: Report response
metrics.description: A report is durably queued quickly even if review is asynchronous.

entities.name: Listing
entities.notes: The listing database is authoritative for ownership, lifecycle, price, and policy state.

entities.name: ListingMedia
entities.notes: Photos live in object storage and are served through signed or public CDN URLs according to policy.

entities.name: SearchDocument
entities.notes: A rebuildable search projection; reads recheck the source listing before display.

entities.name: Conversation
entities.notes: Message access is authorized by participant and listing policy, not by search visibility.

entities.name: Report
entities.notes: Reports are deduplicated and routed to automated and human review queues.

apis.contract: { title, description, price, categoryId, location, mediaIds, requestId } -> { listingId, state }
apis.notes: Validate seller permissions, media ownership, location precision, and abuse limits before committing.
Retrieve bounded candidates from the search index and recheck state, privacy, blocks, and availability.
Authorize and recheck the source record before returning details.
Rate-limit reports and enqueue them durably for moderation.
Create or return the buyer-seller conversation idempotently.

dataFlow.title: Commit the listing
dataFlow.description: The API validates seller, category, price, location, media, and policy constraints, then writes a durable listing version.

dataFlow.title: Index asynchronously
dataFlow.description: A listing event updates text, category, geo, and ranking indexes; index workers retry by listing version.

dataFlow.title: Retrieve candidates
dataFlow.description: Search combines text and geo indexes with filters and a bounded ranking stage, using cache for hot queries.

dataFlow.title: Recheck and serve
dataFlow.description: The marketplace service reads authoritative state or a batched status view to remove deleted, blocked, sold, or policy-violating items.

dataFlow.title: Notify and moderate asynchronously
dataFlow.description: Messages, reports, recommendations, fraud signals, analytics, and seller notifications consume events independently from search reads.

architecture.title: Facebook Marketplace reference architecture
architecture.summary: A listing service owns durable inventory state while media, geo-text search, messaging, moderation, and recommendations scale as separate event-driven projections.

layers.label: Experience and edge
layers.description: Clients submit listings and search through authenticated APIs and caches.

layers.label: Marketplace source
layers.description: Listings, seller permissions, conversations, and media metadata.

layers.label: Search and messaging
layers.description: Rebuildable indexes and durable conversation delivery.

layers.label: Trust and operations
layers.description: Moderation, fraud, notifications, recommendations, and observability.

keyPaths.label: Create listing
keyPaths.description: Client -> gateway -> listing service -> source store -> event stream -> search index.

keyPaths.label: Discover inventory
keyPaths.description: Client -> search service -> index and cache -> source-state recheck -> CDN media.

keyPaths.label: Contact seller
keyPaths.description: Buyer -> listing service -> conversation store -> notification and abuse consumers.

components.label: Marketplace clients
components.description: Create listings, search, inspect details, and message sellers.

components.label: Marketplace gateway
components.description: Authenticates users, applies quotas, and routes commands and queries.

components.label: Listing service
components.description: Owns listing lifecycle, seller authorization, price, location, and policy state.

components.label: Listing store
components.description: Stores authoritative listing versions, seller state, and lifecycle tombstones.

components.label: Media metadata
components.description: Tracks upload ownership, renditions, and processing status.

components.label: Photo object store
components.description: Stores originals and resized listing images with lifecycle policies.

components.label: Marketplace event stream
components.description: Retains listing, report, message, and lifecycle events for projections and replay.

components.label: Geo-text search index
components.description: Indexes listing text, category, geo cells, price, freshness, and ranking features.

components.label: Search service
components.description: Parses queries, retrieves candidates, ranks them, and applies bounded policy filters.

components.label: Media CDN
components.description: Serves authorized listing photos close to viewers.

components.label: Messaging service
components.description: Creates conversations and delivers buyer-seller messages with abuse controls.

components.label: Conversation store
components.description: Stores participant membership, messages, read state, and moderation holds.

components.label: Moderation service
components.description: Scans text and images, processes reports, and issues takedown decisions.

components.label: Fraud and risk
components.description: Detects scams, account abuse, duplicate listings, and suspicious conversations.

components.label: Notifications
components.description: Delivers relevant messages, listing, and moderation notifications with preferences.

components.label: Recommendations and analytics
components.description: Builds discovery features and aggregates marketplace events.

components.label: Marketplace observability
components.description: Tracks index lag, search latency, stale results, fraud queues, and notification failures.

connections.label: Marketplace API
connections.description: Authenticated listing, search, and messaging requests.

connections.label: Listing command
connections.description: The listing service owns source state.

connections.label: Policy recheck
connections.description: Source state prevents stale or deleted results from leaking.

connections.label: Messages
connections.description: Conversation history is durable and ordered per thread.

connections.label: Trust review
connections.description: Reports and content changes enter moderation queues.

connections.label: Risk signals
connections.description: Fraud scoring is decoupled from search availability.

deepDives.title: Geo-text search
points: Index coarse geo cells and query neighboring cells rather than scanning all listings.
Apply price and category filters inside the index, then rank a bounded candidate set.
Use source-state rechecks for deletion, blocks, sold state, and moderation changes.

deepDives.title: Listing freshness
points: Attach a monotonically increasing listing version to events and reject out-of-order index updates.
Expose index lag and fall back to the owner's source view after a successful create.
Use replay and periodic reconciliation to repair missed updates.

deepDives.title: Trust and safety
points: Run image, text, duplicate, and seller-risk checks asynchronously with quarantine for high-risk listings.
Do not reveal exact private seller locations; bucket coordinates to an appropriate area.
Tombstone content and purge CDN media after takedown while preserving audit evidence.

deepDives.title: Messaging safety
points: Authorize every message by conversation membership and listing state.
Rate-limit new conversations, scan links, and support user blocking.
Deliver notifications asynchronously and coalesce bursts for active threads.

tradeoffs.title: Search consistency versus latency
tradeoffs.recommendation: Use an eventually consistent index with authoritative state rechecks on result serving.
tradeoffs.caution: New listings can be briefly absent, so show index lag and provide owner-visible confirmation.

tradeoffs.title: Exact location versus privacy
tradeoffs.recommendation: Store precise coordinates privately but index and display coarse geo buckets.
tradeoffs.caution: Distance results are approximate and need clear user expectations.

tradeoffs.title: Centralized versus per-category indexes
tradeoffs.recommendation: Start with a shared geo-text index and shard by geo/category only when hot spots require it.
tradeoffs.caution: More shards improve isolation but complicate rebalancing and cross-shard pagination.

commonMistakes: Making search the source of truth for listing status.
Indexing precise user locations or returning them in public results.
Blocking listing creation on image processing, recommendations, or moderation completion.
Ignoring out-of-order index events and stale sold or deleted results.
Treating seller messaging as an unauthenticated notification channel.

followUps.question: How do you stop deleted listings from appearing in search?
followUps.answer: Write a source tombstone first, publish a versioned delete event, purge the index and caches, and recheck source state before rendering every result.

followUps.question: How do you handle a local event causing a hot query?
followUps.answer: Cache normalized query results briefly, cap candidate work, shard the hot geo/category partition, and protect the source database with batching and rate limits.

followUps.question: What if an index worker is down?
followUps.answer: Retain events, expose index lag, replay from the last checkpoint, and periodically compare index documents with source records.

followUps.question: How do you protect buyers from scams?
followUps.answer: Combine account and listing risk signals, content scanning, rate limits, user reports, link warnings, and human review with reversible quarantine.

rubric.description: Listing lifecycle, media ownership, and seller authorization are durable and separate from projections.
Geo-text indexing, bounded ranking, cursor pagination, hot-query controls, and freshness are explained.
Moderation, fraud, reports, location precision, deletion, and source rechecks are explicit.
Durable conversations, notifications, replay, lag metrics, and failure recovery are covered.
